title: An inclusive ecosystem
text: Bring together everyone working in AI, Data Science, Machine Learning and Analytics: students, professionals, academics, researchers, industry, entrepreneurs, investors, institutions and government.

title: Education and capacity building
text: Run conferences, seminars, workshops, bootcamps, hackathons, meetups and training. This includes certification, faculty development, mentoring, career guidance, internships and apprenticeships.

title: Centres, labs and hubs
text: Set up or support centres, labs, academies, libraries and knowledge repositories, along with innovation hubs, incubation centres and Centres of Excellence.

title: Collaboration across sectors
text: Help academia, industry, government, civil society and international institutions work together.

title: Research and publishing
text: Carry out research and publish it as journals, case studies, benchmark datasets, technical reports and white papers.

title: Responsible AI
text: Promote AI and Data Science that is responsible, ethical, transparent and trustworthy.

title: Innovation and entrepreneurship
text: Support innovation, incubation and new ventures, including mentoring, introductions to investors and access to markets.

title: Recognising excellence
text: Recognise excellent work through awards, fellowships, certifications and accreditations.

title: National and international links
text: Work with organisations in India and abroad, and take part in global initiatives.

title: Policy and standards
text: Contribute to policies, standards, frameworks and good practice, and advise governments, institutions and industry.

title: Open and community-driven work
text: Encourage collaborative, open-source and community-led projects.

title: AI for social good
text: Design and support projects that use AI for public benefit: in healthcare, agriculture, education, governance, sustainability, climate resilience, public welfare, accessibility, rural development and social inclusion.

title: Institutions and infrastructure
text: Set up or support the institutions, facilities and infrastructure that these objects need.

title: Training and advice by sector
text: Offer training and advisory services across industries, directly or through Special Interest Groups.

title: Intellectual property
text: Create, protect and share intellectual property.

title: Other lawful activities
text: Do anything else that is lawful and supports these objects, always on a not-for-profit basis.
